Dear {vendor} team,

Thank you for your notice that the price of our {plan} plan under {agreement} will change from {old_price} to {new_price}, an increase of {increase_pct} ({monthly_increase} per month, or {annual_impact} per year), effective {effective_date}.

We would like to keep our current pricing. Before the new price takes effect, please confirm whether you can hold our plan at {old_price}. If that is not possible, we would welcome a discussion of options, such as a different plan level, a longer term or other adjustments that would reduce the increase.

We would appreciate a response by {deadline} so we can decide how to proceed before the next billing date. Please reply to this email or contact our accounts-payable team to arrange a call.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Kind regards,
{sender}
